title: Settings
languageHelp: The choice stays on this device. It is not sent to the class.
numberHelp: This only changes how numbers look. The math stays the same.
intro: Privacy, account, and classroom controls. MathLift never uses student data for ads.
voiceHelp: Turn the speaking voice on or off. Your choice stays on this device. This is separate from sound effects.
voiceToggleHint: When off, MathLift will not speak and speaker buttons stay hidden. Sound effects use a different switch.
voicePickerIntro: OpenAI Cedar is the speaking voice for every read-aloud in MathLift.
voiceSpeedHelp: Slower can help early readers follow along.
voicePickerHelp: OpenAI Cedar is selected for lessons.
voiceCloudPickerHelp: MathLift uses OpenAI Cedar for speaking.
voiceAlloyReady: MathLift uses OpenAI Cedar — a clear, natural male voice — for read-aloud. Lesson text is sent only to create spoken audio.
voiceAlloyListHint: Sample: “The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.” Every lesson uses this same natural male voice.
voiceAlloyFallback: Play sample needs cloud TTS. Lesson read-aloud needs OPENAI_API_KEY for live Cedar.
voiceDeviceListHelp: These are installed on your phone. Lessons still use OpenAI Cedar when the cloud voice is ready.
voiceAutoHint: Automatically pick the clearest installed voice.
voiceNone: No voice for this language is installed on this device. Text stays on screen.
voiceSampleFailed: Could not play the voice sample. Tap Play sample again.
voiceLowQualityTip: For a nicer voice, install an Enhanced voice in your device settings.
voiceNaturalHelp: Uses the clearest voice available. Prefers a clear cloud voice when configured, then an on-device English model (~90 MB once), then your device voice.
voiceNaturalCloudReady: Clear cloud voice is ready. Lesson text is sent only to create spoken audio.
voiceAiDisclosure: This speaking voice is AI-generated and is not a human voice.
voiceNaturalLoading: Getting the natural voice ready. This happens once.
voiceNaturalReady: Natural voice is ready on this device.
voiceNaturalError: Natural voice could not load. Using the device voice instead.
